summary: Persistent inline message with tone, optional title, actions and dismiss button.

usage.text: The dismissible attribute shows a close button that only fires a dismiss event (no detail). The alert stays in place until the page removes or hides it.
The title slot renders in a p, not a heading. Tones default and info show no icon unless the icon slot is filled; success, warning and danger show a default icon.

a11y.text: announcement defaults to off, so no live region. polite gives the title and body role=status, assertive gives role=alert. The actions slot is outside the live region.
The dismiss button is always named "Dismiss alert". When the page removes the alert on dismiss, move focus somewhere sensible, since the focused button goes with it.
